name: Shallow-water hake
description: Shallow-water Cape hake (Merluccius capensis), the inshore hake of the trawl fishery. Life-stage group of the source's small (under 3 years) and large (3 years and older) stanzas, pooled into one node per species; the deep-water hake is kept as a separate node because the source tracks it as a different species. Hake feed on anchovy, sardine, squid and smaller hake, and are eaten by seals, sharks and bigger hake.
